hypothesis: The 60-day momentum trial showed strongly negative Sharpe in both train (-0.71) and validation (-1.05), so relative strength has been reversing rather than persisting in this liquid universe. That negative momentum result is consistent with short-horizon mean reversion dominating, so this trial flips to a reversal family using a short 5-day lookback with no skip, buying recent losers and selling recent winners; the top/bottom 25% fraction keeps turnover and cost exposure comparable while testing whether the sign inversion improves net validation Sharpe.
